featured_reviews.name: Rajesh Solanki
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am extremely disappointed with my experience at Ravi Vazirani Design Studio. The designs were not executed properly, and the final output did not match the expectations or discussions we had. Important details were missing, and finishing was careless, which is unacceptable for a professional design studio.

Communication was also weak—there was no proper explanation of design choices, measurements, or materials, leaving me confused and dissatisfied with the end result. For a studio of this reputation, I expected precision, transparency, and attention to detail, but unfortunately, that was not delivered.

I would not recommend this studio to anyone looking for well-detailed, well-finished, or professionally executed designs.
